title_i18n.en: The Hong Kong Privacy Commissioner's Office is concerned about the privacy risks associated with OpenClaw and agentic AI, reminding organizations and the public to use AI safely.
title_i18n.es: La Oficina del Comisionado de Privacidad de Hong Kong expresa preocupación por los riesgos de privacidad asociados con OpenClaw y la IA de agente, e insta a las organizaciones y ciudadanos a utilizar la IA de manera segura.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 36氪获悉，香港个人资料私隐专员公署（简称“香港私隐专员公署”）发布消息，香港私隐专员公署留意到，近期有关使用OpenClaw以及其他代理式人工智能（Agentic AI）的安全风险引起讨论，私隐专员公署亦关注事件，公署提醒机构及市民在部署或使用OpenClaw以及其他代理式AI前，应留意并了解所涉及的个人资料私隐及安全风险，慎防个人资料外泄、系统被恶意接管，以及网络安全风险，并采取充足及有效的安全措施，以保障个人资料私隐。
excerpt_i18n.en: 36Kr has learned that the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data, Hong Kong (PCPD) has issued a notice stating that it has taken note of recent discussions regarding the security risks associated with the use of OpenClaw and other agentic artificial intelligence (Agentic AI). The PCPD is also concerned about the matter and reminds organizations and the public to be aware of and understand the personal data privacy and security risks involved before deploying or using OpenClaw and other agentic AI. They should guard against personal data leakage, malicious system takeovers, and cybersecurity risks, and implement adequate and effective security measures to protect personal data privacy.
excerpt_i18n.es: 36Kr se ha enterado de que la Oficina del Comisionado para la Privacidad de Datos Personales de Hong Kong (conocida como "Oficina del Comisionado de Privacidad de Hong Kong") ha emitido un comunicado. La Oficina ha observado que recientemente se ha generado discusión sobre los riesgos de seguridad asociados al uso de OpenClaw y otras inteligencias artificiales agentivas (Agentic AI). La Oficina también está siguiendo el asunto y recuerda a las organizaciones y ciudadanos que, antes de implementar o utilizar OpenClaw u otras IA agentivas, deben prestar atención y comprender los riesgos para la privacidad de datos personales y la seguridad involucrados. Se debe prevenir la filtración de datos personales, la toma de control maliciosa del sistema y los riesgos de ciberseguridad, adoptando medidas de seguridad adecuadas y efectivas para proteger la privacidad de los datos personales.

items.title: Shard – Stop watching one AI agent code for 45 min. Run four at once
items.raw_excerpt: The biggest bottleneck in AI-assisted coding right now isn't model quality. It's that you give Claude Code or Cursor a complex task and then sit there watching it work for 30-60 minutes. You can't intervene, you can't do anything useful, you just wait. Shard takes that one big prompt and automatically decomposes it into a DAG of parallel sub-tasks. Each task gets exclusive file ownership so there are zero merge conflicts by design. Then it dispatches multiple agents across git worktrees simultaneously, merges in topological order, and self-heals test failures. A 45 minute serial task becomes 4 agents running for 12 minutes. Open source, cross-platform, agent-agnostic (Claude Code, Aider, Cursor).

title_i18n.en: Shard – Stop watching one AI agent code for 45 min. Run four at once
title_i18n.zh: 分片——停止观看单个AI代理编码45分钟。同时运行四个。
title_i18n.es: Shard – Deja de ver a un agente de IA programar durante 45 minutos. Ejecuta cuatro a la vez.

excerpt_i18n.en: The biggest bottleneck in AI-assisted coding right now isn't model quality. It's that you give Claude Code or Cursor a complex task and then sit there watching it work for 30-60 minutes. You can't intervene, you can't do anything useful, you just wait. Shard takes that one big prompt and automatically decomposes it into a DAG of parallel sub-tasks. Each task gets exclusive file ownership so there are zero merge conflicts by design. Then it dispatches multiple agents across git worktrees simultaneously, merges in topological order, and self-heals test failures. A 45 minute serial task becomes 4 agents running for 12 minutes. Open source, cross-platform, agent-agnostic (Claude Code, Aider, Cursor).
excerpt_i18n.zh: 当前AI辅助编程的最大瓶颈并非模型质量，而是当你给Claude Code或Cursor分配复杂任务后，需要静坐观察它工作30到60分钟。你无法干预，也无法参与。

items.title: 达能亚太与阿里云达成AI战略合作
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，达能亚太与阿里云达成战略合作。双方将围绕“AI+健康”的愿景，在全栈AI、大数据及亚太区域公共云合作等多个领域深度共创，共同打造面向AI时代的数智化平台与敏捷组织。 达能集团全球CIO Erwin Logt、阿里云智能集团资深副总裁，公共云事业部总裁刘伟光见证签约，达能集团亚太CIO Shivani Saini与阿里云智能集团公共云事业部副总裁、东区总经理解航代表双方签约，达能中国、北亚及大洋洲信息技术&数据副总裁刘冰等出席签约仪式。 作为一家知名的跨国食品饮料公司，达能在专注健康、快速发展并引领潮流的三大领域开展业务：专业特殊营养、基础乳制品和植物基产品、饮用水和饮料。旗下拥有爱他美、诺优能、脉动、依云等家喻户晓的品牌。 过往，达能中国基于阿里云的公共云全栈技术，成功打造了高效、安全、合规的企业级云平台，不仅有力支撑了企业应用服务的敏捷创新，更极大提升了中国消费者的数字化体验。 面向AI时代，阿里云将全力支持达能将中国的数字化成功经验推广至其他亚太区域，并将协助达能打造具有行业标杆效应的“Landing Zone”企业治理范式和全栈AI最佳实践。 在AI Agent领域，双方将结合阿里巴巴生态资源，在市场营销、电商、渠道销售、客户服务及供应链等关键业务领域，基于千问大模型共同构建场景化的AI智能体，提升达能运营效率和消费者体验。 同时，双方将利用阿里云全球领先的模型与算力服务，以支持达能更高效地研发和创新，并加速健康科技成果转化。 此外，双方还将基于阿里云先进的数据产品和技术升级新一代数据湖，构建“Talk-to-Data”（对话式数据分析）能力，大幅提升企业级数据洞察效率与决策智能化水平，加速业务转型。 此次战略签约，标志着阿里云与达能的合作进一步迈向业务智能化。达能将持续利用先进的数字化技术，持续为全球消费者提供更健康、更优质的产品与服务体验。 雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, Danone Asia-Pacific and Alibaba Cloud have entered into a strategic partnership. Centered on the vision of "AI + Health," the two parties will deeply collaborate across multiple domains, including full-stack AI, big data, and public cloud cooperation in the Asia-Pacific region, jointly building a digital intelligence platform and agile organization for the AI era. Danone Group's Global CIO Erwin Logt and Alibaba Cloud Intelligence Group's Senior Vice President and President of the Public Cloud Business Unit, Liu Weiguang, witnessed the signing. Danone Group's Asia-Pacific CIO Shivani Saini and Alibaba Cloud Intelligence Group's Vice President of the Public Cloud Business Unit and General Manager of the Eastern Region, Xie Hang, signed on behalf of their respective sides. Danone China, North Asia, and Oceania's Vice President of Information Technology & Data, Liu Bing, among others, attended the signing ceremony.

As a well-known multinational food and beverage company, Danone operates in three key areas focused on health, rapid development, and trendsetting: specialized nutrition, essential dairy and plant-based products, and water and beverages. Its portfolio includes household brands such as Aptamil, Nutrilon, Mizone, and Evian.

Previously, Danone China successfully built an efficient, secure, and compliant enterprise-level cloud platform based on Alibaba Cloud's full-stack public cloud technology. This not only robustly supported agile innovation in enterprise application services but also significantly enhanced the digital experience for Chinese consumers.

In the AI era, Alibaba Cloud will fully support Danone in extending its successful digitalization experience from China to other Asia-Pacific regions. It will also assist Danone in establishing an industry-benchmark "Landing Zone" enterprise governance model and best practices for full-stack AI.

excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Danone Asia-Pacific y Alibaba Cloud han establecido una colaboración estratégica. Ambas partes trabajarán en profundidad en múltiples áreas, como la IA integral, big data y la cooperación en la nube pública en la región de Asia-Pacífico, en torno a la visión de "IA + salud", para crear conjuntamente una plataforma digital inteligente y una organización ágil para la era de la IA. El CIO global del Grupo Danone, Erwin Logt, y el vicepresidente sénior del Grupo de Inteligencia de Alibaba Cloud y presidente de la División de Nube Pública, Liu Weiguang, presenciaron la firma. La CIO de Danone Asia-Pacífico, Shivani Saini, y el vicepresidente de la División de Nube Pública del Grupo de Inteligencia de Alibaba Cloud y gerente general de la Zona Este, Xie Hang, firmaron en representación de ambas partes. También asistieron Liu Bing, vicepresidente de Tecnología de la Información y Datos de Danone China, Norte de Asia y Oceanía, entre otros.

items.title: Are there any CS niches safe from AI?
items.raw_excerpt: I'll be graduating with a SWE degree soon and the thought of spending my career reviewing AI code just seems both awful and unsustainable. Programming has been fun because it is difficult. It required skill which is continously grown by the act of writing more code. Using code gen is boring, doesn't require much skill, and tends to atrophy your understanding of the subject. Does anyone have any experience with nearby niches to software engineering which might have some inherent property that makes AI code gen not possible? OS development? Embedded? Computer Architecture? Something I've never heard of? If possible, I'd like to pivot while I'm still young.

excerpt_i18n.en: On March 14, 2026, AWE (Appliance & Electronics World Expo), one of the world's top three home appliance and consumer electronics exhibitions, was grandly held in Shanghai. The event gathered top global technology brands and cutting-edge consumer electronics achievements, making it an annual bellwether for the tech industry. At this highly anticipated industry event, Dreame Technology ushered in a significant moment—the global launch of its new-generation flagship smart hardware product, the Dreame AI Ring Glow. With breakthrough health monitoring technology, this product became the world's first AI smart ring featuring fingertip ECG analysis combined with heart rate and blood oxygen analysis, completely breaking the technical barriers of traditional health wearables and ushering in a new era of AI fingertip health management. At the launch event, Pan Zhidong, President of Dreame's Global AI Hardware Business Group, delivered a keynote speech, joining on-site media, partners, and consumers in witnessing a new milestone in the AI smart wearable track. Pan Zhidong stated: "We always adhere to the philosophy that 'all hardware is worth redoing with AI,' deeply addressing users' core pain points and striving to create aesthetically pleasing, user-friendly, durable hardware products that truly enable AI to serve people. The launch of the Dreame AI Ring Glow represents another disruptive breakthrough in the field of AI health wearables, aiming to break down the high barriers of professional health management through the innovative model of 'ring + AI,' allowing everyone to easily own a personalized fingertip health assistant." excerpt_i18n.es: El 14 de marzo de 2026, la Exposición de Electrodomésticos y Electrónica de Consumo de China (AWE), uno de los tres mayores eventos mundiales del sector, se celebró con gran éxito en Shanghái. El evento reunió a las principales marcas tecnológicas globales y los avances más vanguardistas en electrónica de consumo, consolidándose como referente anual de la industria tecnológica. En este esperado acontecimiento, Dreame Technology alcanzó un hito crucial: el lanzamiento mundial de su nueva generación de producto insignia, el anillo inteligente Dreame AI Glow. Gracias a su tecnología revolucionaria de monitorización de salud, este dispositivo se convierte en el primer anillo inteligente con IA del mundo que combina análisis de electrocardiograma desde la yema del dedo con monitorización de frecuencia cardíaca y oxigenación sanguínea, superando las limitaciones técnicas de los wearables tradicionales e inaugurando una nueva era de gestión de salud mediante IA desde la punta de los dedos.

excerpt_i18n.en:

1. Meta reportedly plans 20% layoffs: 15,800 face unemployment! Zuckerberg previously discussed AI efficiency, claiming "one person can replace a team."
